decision: 11_DEPLOYMENT §6 and ADR-024: list every APP_HOST service process that opens a PostgreSQL pool. nexloop-doctor --budget-only sums pool max x process count (<= 60), requires every long-running service (nexloop_eios.connection_budget.required_services) to be declared, and requires the server's max_connections >= 80 before any service starts. Process counts follow 11_DEPLOYMENT §7; adjust this file together with the service configuration. NX-031 D7 (dispatcher 2026-10-11, measured smallest workable pools): the eleven background services 1 each (POOL_MAX; AT-043 added incentive-issuer); the plan-reevaluator and reply-guarantor launchers' nexloop_api pools 2 (with one no Run is issued); domain-worker, action-worker, message-relay and outbound-recorder 2 (with one they time out or fail); the runtime-worker dispatcher 2; api 4 per process and the four guard processes 4 each are kept (lowering them needs the nightly ACK data and a rerun of the ADR-022 deadline gate). scheduler: the nexloop-scheduler command of the handoff Compose template; the current code has no such entry point; its 4 are kept as a reserve. Total 53. NX-031 (dispatcher 2026-10-11): runtime-worker dispatch_loops 4 = the Agent Host maximum_active_runs (one Run per loop; the loops share the dispatcher pool and add no connection); the doctor requires processes x dispatch_loops <= 4 (ADR-022 §4). NX-032 (L5 review; dispatcher ruling 2026-10-11): each API process also opens the browser identity pool (nexloop_identity; only with browser login, shared by the customer and workbench realms), declared as api-browser-identity: 2 processes x 4 (the code default, --identity-pool-max 4). The scheduler reserve of 4 is removed: it stood for the handoff template's nexloop-scheduler entry point, which no NexLoop process implements; this ruling supersedes the NX-031 D7 note that kept it as a reserve. Total 57 (3 to spare). The Compose example labels each container with its budget entry and doctor --deploy-gate compares both ways without exceptions (the two launcher pools live inside plan-reevaluator and reply-guarantor). NX-037 provider routing: webchat-delivery (the NexLoop delivery service of nexloop.service.request, nexloop_action_worker role) 1 process, pool 2. Relay processes 2 (dispatcher 2026-10-13, option B of docs/implementation/relay-step-timing.md §3; AT-060 C4-low passes with two relays): message-relay 2 processes x 2, each with its own vault (compose message-relay and message-relay-2); the 2 connections come from api-browser-identity 4 -> 3 per process (--identity-pool-max 3), pending the login-peak retest (docs/implementation/relay2-budget.md). Total 59. NX-038 E3 wiring (dispatcher 2026-10-22, L6 review 5.1): message-relay semantic_read_pool_max 1 per process (the Context assembly's semantic-read pool, --semantic-read-pool-max 1; +2), api-browser-identity 3 -> 2 per process (--identity-pool-max 2; -2), pending the login-peak retest on the load lane (docs/implementation/relay2-budget.md §4 with LOAD_IDENTITY_POOL_MAX=2). The fallback reply Run reads no semantics: reply-guarantor +0. Total 59.
